# agent-adoption-triage

> An Agent Skill (MIT) holding a five-question triage for routing AI work to the right architecture — script, algorithmic search, LLM workflow, or autonomous agentic loop — before any agent is built. The core inversion: the question is not whether an agent can do the work, but whether accountability can still be distributed after deployment. Route the work first; pick the architecture second.

## Core documentation

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): self-contained Q&A reference for AI agents (Project Facts, Prior Research, question-form H2 sections)
- [README.md](README.md): human-facing narrative (install, five-questions table, curation model)
- [SKILL.md](skills/agent-adoption-triage/SKILL.md): full skill specification — the Business AI Quadrants, the five questions with tests, per-quadrant governance sets, hybrid guidance, 10-item anti-patterns checklist, triage record template

## Architecture

- Four **Business AI Quadrants** classify the work (not the agent): deterministic × semantic-judgment on one axis, pre-defined × exploratory control flow on the other — (1) Script, (2) Algorithmic Search, (3) LLM Workflow, (4) Autonomous Agentic Loop
- **Five questions**: Q0 design/operation phase → Q1 deterministic rules? → Q2 static-finite search space? → Q3 workflow drawable in advance? → Q4 pre-named gap-bearer + Phase-crossing decision?
- **Load-bearing asymmetry**: in the LLM Workflow Quadrant each call's contribution is post-hoc separable and redirect succeeds; in the Autonomous Agentic Loop Quadrant judgment elements blend at runtime and the **attribution gap** is non-removable — it can only be absorbed by a pre-named **gap-bearer**
- **Phase is a third dimension**: every quadrant can appear in design or operation phase; operation-phase Quadrant-4 placements additionally require a recorded **Phase-crossing decision** (handle new patterns in place vs route back to design)
- Audit layer: per-quadrant governance sets with redirect paths, 10-item anti-patterns checklist, triage record template
- Provenance: the "how" counterpart to [AAP ADR-0009/0010](https://github.com/shimo4228/agent-attribution-practice/tree/main/docs/adr); installable publication of the [AAP `docs/quadrants/`](https://github.com/shimo4228/agent-attribution-practice/tree/main/docs/quadrants) navigator
